remarks: FEES: HOA & SPECIAL DISTRICT TAX $996/mo + $8,893/yr GREENWICH TOWN TAXES. Please note Zillow Payment Calculator is incorrect, taxes are NOT $33,000/yr, can be verified by listing agent. Conveniently located minutes from Greenwich Ave., this 3 bed, 3.5 bath townhouse is pure elegance and sophistication in every corner. Stunning gourmet Deane kitchen fully-equipped with deluxe Wolf appliances, steam oven, induction stove, Sub-Zero refrigerator, wine chiller and oversized island perfect for entertaining. Open concept dining and living rooms with wood burning fireplace, study and access to serene waterfront views from private outdoor deck. Second floor consists of oversized primary suite with newly updated primary bath, two additional bedrooms, laundry room, and additional full bath. A versatile, finished third floor offers many possibilities such as fourth bedroom, guest suite, home office, media/playroom and has a brand new full bathroom. Additional features include community pool and EV charger. Experience low maintenance, stylishly designed, luxury living less than an hour from New York City!  Room dimensions & square footage deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Verify any room size important to buyer. Tax Card address is 16 Valley Road
